lines.text: Jesus went to the region of Tyre, and a Greek woman fell at His feet about her daughter.
Jesus said tossing the children's bread to the pigs was not right, but told her the demon had left.
She found her child lying on the bed, and Jesus went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee.
People begged Jesus to place His hand on a deaf man, so He put His fingers in his eyes.
The man spoke plainly, Jesus ordered them to tell no one, and the people said He makes the deaf hear.
